A: The docker commands are executed by the app without "sudo" so you will need to add your non-root user to the docker group with the following command:

Xtream Ahoy! allows you to browse your playlist of IPTV channels and movies via Xtream codes. Browse the contents of your favorite playlists, discover channels and movies right at your fingertips. Unlock the power to access your favorite live TV channels and movies effortlessly and in style. 

Important Notes: 
- The app does not supply any live channels by its now.
- As of now, Xtream Ahoy! exclusively supports live channels and movies.
- Xtream ahoy! does NOT include any media player for watching your channels.
- Playback will require external apps like VLC (recommended).

Features:

• Super Fast Channel surfing: Xtream Ahoy! lets you effortlessly navigate through your playlists instantly. Say goodbye to endless loading times and scrolling and enjoy quick access to your favorite content.

• Secure Access, Peace of Mind: Your security is our priority. Xtream Ahoy! ensures your personal data remains confidential and secure in the Keychain, allowing you to enjoy seamless streaming without worrying about privacy concerns.

• Multiple Playlist Support: Xtream Ahoy! makes managing multiple playlists a breeze. Effortlessly explore live channels from various sources without complex configurations or technical expertise.

• Watch in VLC Player: Xtream Ahoy! enhances your streaming experience further by enabling you to open live channels directly in the VLC media player. Enjoy a seamless transition from Xtream Ahoy! to VLC and get the best possible experience.

• Deep Link Configuration: Customize your streaming experience with Xtream Ahoy's advanced deep link configuration. Seamlessly integrate your preferred live streaming sources using the deep link: xtream-ahoy://launch?url=YOUR_URL&username=YOUR_USERNAME&password=YOUR_PASSWORD.
